name: mathexplorer
description: Interactive experiments in zeta-zero geometry and the Riemann hypothesis.

scripts.build: (node scripts/fleet-status-writer.mjs || true) && node scripts/audit-nav-links.mjs && node scripts/check-bundle-sizes.mjs && vite build
scripts.assert: npm run audit:rh && node scripts/run-assertions.mjs --fail-inject && node scripts/audit-nav-links.mjs && node scripts/run-assertions.mjs && node scripts/reproduce-headline-numbers.mjs
scripts.assert:pr: npm run audit:rh && node scripts/run-assertions.mjs --fail-inject && node scripts/audit-nav-links.mjs && node scripts/run-assertions.mjs --fast --since-ref=origin/main && node scripts/reproduce-headline-numbers.mjs && node scripts/smoke-tests.mjs
scripts.test:all: node scripts/smoke-tests.mjs && node scripts/check-page-health.mjs && node scripts/test-buttons.mjs
